nightState.booked: Night taken by a confirmed booking

calendar.checkoutExplain: {{guest}} checks out this morning; it does not count as an occupied night.
calendar.selectHint: Tap a day to see the details. Today is {{date}}.

prospects.nonBlockingHint: Prospects do not block the calendar. Only a temporary hold or a confirmed booking does.
prospects.empty: There are no periods with prospects. Create one with “New period”.
prospects.noCandidates: There are no prospects for this period yet.
prospects.confirmSummary: A confirmed booking will be created for {{guest}}, {{dates}}, at {{property}}, and those dates will be blocked.
prospects.ownHoldConverted: This prospect's temporary hold will be converted into the booking.
prospects.severalHolds: Several holds cover these dates. Release them one by one before confirming.
prospects.overrideCheck: Override {{guest}}'s hold and confirm this prospect
prospects.overrideReason: Reason for the override (it is recorded)
prospects.overrideAdminOnly: Only an admin can override another prospect's hold. You can also wait for it to expire or ask for it to be released.
prospects.discardOthers_one: Discard the other prospect for this period ({{names}})
prospects.discardOthers_other: Discard the other {{count}} prospects for this period ({{names}})
prospects.overlapWarning: Prospects in other periods overlap these dates; they are not deleted:

enquiryWarning.held: These dates are temporarily held. You can record the prospect, but not confirm or hold until the hold is released or expires.
enquiryWarning.booked: These dates already have a confirmed booking. You can still record the prospect in case they become free.

holds.confirmExplain: While the hold lasts nobody else can confirm or hold overlapping dates. When it expires the dates become free automatically and the prospect is kept.
holds.releaseExplain: The dates {{dates}} will no longer be held for {{guest}} and anyone can hold or confirm them. {{guest}} remains a prospect.
holds.expiredNotRecorded: Expired on {{when}}; the expiry record is written with the next operation on the property.

pricing.title: Price

calc.per_week: {{count}} full weeks × {{rate}} + {{extra}} extra nights at 1/7 of the rate = {{total}}.
calc.per_month: {{count}} full months × {{rate}} + {{extra}} extra nights in proportion to the days of that month = {{total}}.

pricing.ambiguous: The stay is not whole weeks or months: this is only a proposal, type the agreed total.
pricing.depositHint: Only warns when missing; it never prevents confirming.

bookings.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, phone or email…
bookings.confirmedHint: blocks the dates in the calendar.
bookings.provisionalHint: draft; does not block the dates until confirmed.
bookings.datesChangeWarning: You are changing the dates of a booking that blocks the calendar. The new dates will be checked for availability.
bookings.cancelExplain: The dates will become free. The booking and its payments stay in the history; nothing is deleted.
bookings.cancelPaidHint: {{amount}} has been received. If you give any of it back, record it afterwards as a refund.
bookings.cancellationFeeHint: Amount the family keeps, for the record only.
bookings.creditNotice: {{amount}} too much has been received. It stays visible as a credit until it is refunded or corrected.

payments.refundHint: Net received so far: {{netPaid}}. The refund cannot exceed it.
payments.voidExplain: The {{amount}} record ({{type}}) will stop counting towards balances. It is not deleted: it stays in the history with the reason.
payments.netHelp: Receipts minus refunds for the selection

installments.title: Payment schedule
installments.explain: An instalment is a plan, not money received. Actual payments are recorded separately.
installments.diffUnder: The instalments add up to {{amount}} less than the agreed price.
installments.diffOver: The instalments add up to {{amount}} more than the agreed price.
installments.invalid: Check the instalments: each needs a date and an amount above zero.
installments.convention: Money received is applied to the oldest instalments first.

guests.contactAlreadyRegistered: {{name}} is already registered, so the existing guest was selected.
guests.contactPickFailed: The phone contacts could not be opened. Type the details instead.
guests.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, phone or email…
guests.duplicateWarning: This may already exist: {{names}}. If it is someone else, carry on.
guests.phoneHint: Include the country code (+34…) for the WhatsApp link.
guests.notesHint: Do not store identity documents or bank details.
guests.dataExplain: Archiving hides the contact from lists. Anonymising permanently removes name, phone, email and notes, but keeps bookings and payments.
guests.anonymizeExplain: The name, phone, email and notes of {{name}} will be erased. This cannot be undone. Their bookings and payments are kept without personal data.

reports.disclaimer: Agreed value, cash received and profit are different things. This app does not calculate taxes, expenses or profit.

help.agreedValue: Agreed price of confirmed and completed bookings (cancelled ones excluded), split by nights: a stay that crosses years counts in each year according to its nights.
help.bookingsCount: Confirmed or completed bookings with at least one night in the year.
help.occupiedNights: Out of {{available}} available nights in the year.
help.occupancy: Nights of confirmed and completed bookings divided by the nights of the year. Prospects and temporary holds do not count.
help.averagePerNight: Agreed value for the year divided by occupied nights.
help.netReceipts: Receipts minus refunds with a payment date in the year, whatever the dates of the stay.
help.outstanding: What is still owed on all confirmed and completed bookings, of any year. Cancelled bookings are not included.
help.overdue: Scheduled instalments dated before today that are not yet covered by what has been received.

settings.languageExplain: Saved on this device and in your account.
settings.timeZoneHint: Used for hold deadlines and to decide what “today” is.
settings.membersExplain: Only the people on this list can see and change the data.
settings.inviteExplain: The person gets access once they sign in with that confirmed email address. Their user account is created by an admin in Supabase; no email is sent from here.

hold.overridden: Hold overridden to confirm another prospect
